title: Four Killed in Houthi Strike on Red Sea Ship, Yemeni Government Says
summary_full: The Yemeni government said the ship was carrying food supplies to a port on the Bab al-Mandab Strait while the Iran-backed Houthis accused Saudi Arabia of transporting weapons.
